outcome: maternal and perinatal morbidity and mortality
cohort: 100 antepartum patients who presented with abruptio placentae to the Department of Obstetrics, Kurnool medical college over 1.5 years
finding: Pre-eclampsia and anemia were the most common risk factors for abruptio placentae, and there was a significant association between the grade of abruption and perinatal outcome.
mod_finding: 74% of the study population underwent vaginal delivery while 26% underwent LSCS.
